target: Align Docker CI with the canonical Compose build fleet and publish immutable GHCR images with provenance.
invariants: Runtime and normalized compose wiring remain higher authority than generated CI metadata.
Pull requests never publish images or receive registry credentials unnecessarily.
Main and release publication uses GHCR with GITHUB_TOKEN and immutable SHA tags.
Docker Scout credentials are optional and may not block container build verification when absent.
No Docker Hub publication occurs from the Dopemux container workflow.
Every Compose build service is mapped to a CI target or an explicit exclusion.

commit.message: fix(ci): align container builds and GHCR publishing

pr.title: fix(ci): align container builds and GHCR publishing
pr.body: Build the canonical Dopemux container fleet from one checked-in manifest, publish immutable GHCR images on main and release tags, capture digests and provenance, and make Docker Scout fail-safe when its Docker Hub credentials are unavailable.

steps.task: Create one machine-readable inventory covering every custom Compose build service and retained legacy compatibility image.
requirements: Classify each target as canonical, support, or legacy compatibility.
Record context, Dockerfile, GHCR image name, Compose services, and smoke-test metadata.
validation: Manifest schema and path validation pass.
Every Compose service with build configuration is covered exactly once.

steps.task: Refactor container CI to consume the manifest, build pull requests, and publish main or release images to GHCR.
requirements: Publish SHA, main/latest, and semantic version tags as applicable.
Capture image digest and generate registry-backed provenance attestation.
validation: Publish condition is limited to main and v* tag pushes.

steps.task: Make Docker Scout analysis optional when Docker Hub credentials are missing and prevent Docker Hub image publication.
requirements: No login action receives empty credentials.
Missing credentials produce a warning and successful skipped analysis.
validation: Workflow contains an explicit credential capability gate.
Scout build-push action has push false.

steps.task: Validate the inventory against Docker Compose's normalized build paths and fail closed on unmapped or conflicting services.
requirements: Use docker compose config output rather than filename assumptions.
Do not edit Compose when normalized runtime evidence already resolves wrapper paths.
No service authority or port changes are introduced.
validation: docker compose config is structurally valid.
Manifest and normalized Compose Dockerfile paths agree.
